common_assumptions: Single-pass rule application is sufficient without re-verification
Tool output is complete and not truncated
File state matches what was last read earlier in the chain
Command success signals content correctness, not just execution success
Context supplied in the prompt is current and sufficient
strength_patterns: Narrow scoped tasks (style enforcement, juror verdicts) are resolved efficiently in a single step with no wasted overhead
Complex multi-step chains systematically read files before edits and interleave test/build verification commands
High-step chains mix exploratory search (rg, head) with targeted edits, reducing blind-edit risk
weakness_patterns: Same files re-read many times in long chains (e.g., one doc read 9× in a single chain) indicates findings are not retained or integrated across steps
Approximately 70% of chains are single-step with zero externalized reasoning, making assumption failures and unconsidered alternatives invisible
Thinking steps appear in under 5% of chains; implicit reasoning makes overconfidence undetectable until output is wrong
